verdict.rationale: WezTerm's `cli` subcommand can enumerate all windows, tabs and panes (`wezterm cli list`) and send text to or read text from individual panes by pane-id. A hands-on probe verified this works headlessly, so a script could loop over many panes to approximate bulk operations. However, every documented operation targets a single pane, and nothing shows a native bulk or broadcast capability. Missing for 10: native multi-pane/broadcast input or batch commands, documented bulk-operation workflows, and independent evidence of bulk use across many items.
